title: Analog Fit
plain_reading: The platform separates repeated matrix math from model parts that still need digital logic.
what_this_supports: A partial analog fit may exist for linear layers, projection layers, and feed-forward blocks.
what_this_does_not_prove: It does not prove the full workload should run on analog.
It does not prove the physical chip can place or run the candidate layers.
next_actions: List analog candidates and digital-required regions.
Send candidates to analog accuracy and layout checks.
